model_annotations.Bulgarian: This diagram presents a Venn diagram comparing character types, comprising two concentric circles divided into sectors. The inner circle is divided into two sectors: "Real Characters" in green, which includes the sectors "Custom Characters" in pink, and the surrounding sector includes "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", and "Influencers" in various shades of green, and "Virtual Characters" in blue, which includes the sectors "Comic Characters", "Movie Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters", and "Game Characters". The diagram does not include a legend; however, the sectors are labeled with their respective names. No percentages are provided, and none of the sectors are visually highlighted. The sectors in the inner circle appear to be arranged in a specific order, with "Real Characters" and "Virtual Characters" being the two main categories.
model_annotations.English: This chart represents a hierarchical categorization of character types, using concentric circles to group and subdivide categories. The chart is divided into two main sections: "Real Characters" and "Virtual Characters". The "Real Characters" section is further divided into 10 slices, including "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", and "Influencers", with approximate proportions of 5%, 5%, 5%, 10%, 10%, 15%, and 15%, respectively; the remaining three categories appear to comprise around 5-10% each, but their exact proportions are not easily estimable. The "Virtual Characters" section is divided into 6 slices, including "Game Characters", "Novel Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Movie Characters", and "Comic Characters", with "Custom Characters" represented as a small slice within the "Virtual Characters" section, but its proportion is not easily estimable. A legend is not explicitly provided, but the categories are labeled directly on the chart; no slices are visually emphasized beyond their hierarchical organization. The segments appear to be arranged in no particular order within their respective sections.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm stellt die Kategorien von Charakteren dar, unterteilt in zwei Hauptkategorien: "Real Characters" und "Virtual Characters". Die Kategorie "Real Characters" wird weiter in 10 Subkategorien unterteilt: Influencers, Actors, Musicians, Writers, Athletes, Artists, Scientists, Custom Characters. Die Kategorie "Virtual Characters" wird in 6 Subkategorien unterteilt: Game Characters, Novel Characters, Teleplay Characters, Movie Characters und Comic Characters. Insgesamt werden 16 Segmente dargestellt. Die Segmente haben unterschiedliche Farben, sind aber nicht explizit in der Legende beschrieben. Es gibt keine Prozentangaben innerhalb der Segmente oder eine Legende. Die Segmente sind in keiner bestimmten Reihenfolge angeordnet.
